requirement: Collect, organise and analyse against a full list of requirements
how: Every requirement in the brief is listed, mapped to an artefact and a status; gaps are named rather than hidden.

requirement: Suggest how to improve the site for decision-making, with a dedicated section someone can review before implementing
how: 16 suggestions, each with problem, recommendation, impact, effort, confidence, evidence, decision state and the test that would change the call.

requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision; suggestions to discover missing information
how: 18 questions split into answered / partially answered / blocking, each with what we have, what is missing and the cheapest way to obtain it.
gap: Four questions cannot be closed from public data (line timing, prop lines, reward funding, jurisdiction).

how: Own spread and total for all 14 Week 10 games, built from a ridge rating model on 2025-2026 results plus an injury adjustment; walk-forward backtest published.
gap: Market comparison uses an aggregator line (F01), not a verified operator snapshot.

requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
how: Seven pre-registered families tested on 1980-2026 data with exact binomial tests, Wilson intervals, chronological holdouts and permutation nulls.
gap: No family clears all gates; the injury family is the only one with a mechanism, and its ATS edge is zero.

requirement: Leaderboard competition with rewards for top-performing strategies
how: Ranking rule published (gates passed, then win rate), reward tiers defined, anti-gaming rules and registration of every tested variant.
gap: No certified entrant, so the board is intentionally empty; reward funding and jurisdiction unset (Q04).

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player prop bet combos
how: Singles (S1-S7), two-leg parlay maths, and same-team prop-combo correlation with an SGP pricing table.
gap: Prop *lines* are not available from an official source, so prop legs are modelled at median splits (F03).

requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates
how: Gates G0-G12 evaluated per strategy; a strategy is only CERTIFIED when every hard gate passes.
gap: G4 (CLV) and G8 (market integrity) cannot pass without verified price history (F01/F02).

how: Pearson r for prop pairs and phi for parlay legs, computed from nflverse weekly stats and schedules, with Fisher intervals.

requirement: Remove luck and build selectively skill-based strategies
how: Exact binomial tests, Bonferroni over the number of variants tested, chronological holdouts, 500-draw permutation nulls, break-even-at-price discipline.
gap: Skill cannot be certified without verified closing prices; the honest output is 'no certified edge'.

how: All 276 player rows on the official Week 10 report parsed from nfl.com with per-row source links and retrieval timestamp; cross-checked against an independent mirror.
gap: Game statuses publish later in the week; only 6 rows carried a game status at retrieval (F04).

requirement: Know defensive deficiencies where 2nd/3rd/4th string replace starters
how: Depth string inferred from snap share within team and position group; replacement drop measured against the next available player on the same unit.
gap: Snap-share role inference is not an official depth chart (F05).

requirement: Same for offences using starters or backups
how: Offence and defence deficiency are reported separately, by position group, with the starter flag and depth string visible per player.

requirement: Executive summary outlining the important details
how: One page: what is verified, what is computed, what is missing, what to decide next.

requirement: No manual input from the owner
how: Fetch, parse, compute, build and verify run unattended; the only human action is reviewing the suggestions register.
gap: Data refresh depends on the GitHub Actions runner having network access (documented).

requirement: Verify line by line from official sources, link everything, flag irregularities, no hallucinations
how: 32/32 clubs' official standings reproduce exactly from an independent game log; 11 prior claims re-derived, 5 of which do not reproduce and are flagged.
gap: Market prices, prop lines and closing lines have no official public source (F01-F03).

requirement: GitHub Pages site: clean landing page, category subpages, tables, all findings
how: Static, no JavaScript required for content, consistent navigation, every table row sourced or explicitly flagged.

requirement: Coordinate with other parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md
how: Scope claimed and pushed before any work; additive namespaces only; no file owned by another session was edited.

requirement: Open a PR, merge autonomously, confirm Pages deploys, record the result
how: PR merged without waiting, Pages build verified live, links and rows re-checked after deploy.
